verdict.rationale: Svelte ships a first-party MCP server that helps AI agents write better Svelte code by supplying documentation and statically analysing generated code. That is an AI-oriented analysis tool from Svelte itself, but the evidence never says it inspects a component tree or recommends specific rendering or reactivity optimizations. missing for 10: devtools-style component-tree analysis, explicit rendering/reactivity optimization suggestions, any performance-focused documentation of the analyzer, independent or hands-on corroboration.
